index($0, "{{FILENAME_GRAMMAR_SINCE}}") { print "filename-grammar-since: " since; next }
No renderer drops or rewrites the line otherwise.

Step 2: in reconcile_config (around setup.sh:279), before building cand, read the existing date:
since="$(grep -E '^filename-grammar-since:' config/repo-state.md | head -1 | sed -E 's/^filename-grammar-since:[[:space:]]*//')"
default to empty (renderers then stamp today). Pass $since into the render_github / render_gitlab / render_local calls in that function. Do NOT add filename-grammar-since to the for k in autonomy-default tracker-remote-ack carry-forward loop - the renderer already emits the line, and a second append would duplicate it.

grep -q "^filename-grammar-since: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)\$" "$REF/config/repo-state.md" \
  || fail "fresh render did not stamp filename-grammar-since with today's date"

(b) Preserve-on-reconcile: in the v2-era fixture block (the V sandbox whose config starts at template-version: 2), add the line filename-grammar-since: 2026-01-01 to the fixture config directly after the template-version: 2 line, and after the accepted re-render add VERBATIM:

  || fail "accepted re-render did not preserve the earlier filename-grammar-since date"
[ "$(grep -c '^filename-grammar-since:' "$V/config/repo-state.md")" -eq 1 ] \
  || fail "reconcile duplicated the filename-grammar-since key (renderer plus carry-forward)"

Step 4: run bash tests/loop-setup/reconcile.sh - expect FAIL first if Steps 1-2 are not yet in place, then PASS.

HOW TO RUN (from repo root): bash tests/loop-setup/reconcile.sh ; bash tests/loop-setup/docs-gitlab.sh

OUTPUT CONTRACT: setup.sh renders and preserves the grammar key as specified; reconcile.sh carries both new assertions verbatim and passes; docs-gitlab.sh still passes.

FINAL STEP: do NOT git commit and do not create commits; leave every change uncommitted in the worktree. The harness exports your diff and the orchestrator applies and commits it as: doc-filename-tokens: render and preserve filename-grammar-since in setup
